LAW29_TRANSPORT.SHAM_NORMALIZED_TRANSPORT: the ONLINE trigger's registration floor and kappa are unchanged, but the SPACING is rescaled to LAW_29's own relaxation time, estimated ONLY from LAW_29 SHAM blocks of this same confirmation cohort, as spacing = 16 * (tau29 / tau16) rounded to the nearest power of two, where tau is the number of steps for a SHAM block's tracked mass autocorrelation proxy |T(t)-T(t+d)|/T to reach 0.02. No treated block is used to compute it.
LAW29_TRANSPORT.STRICT_POLICY_TRANSPORT: identical physical parameters: floor, ceil, quantum M256/80, spacing 16, kappa 0.9, registration floor 0.10

adjudication.rule: after both transports fail, no third rescue tuned on the results is created

LAW29_TRANSPORT.what_counts_as_confirming_under_LAW_29: a policy that raises ITT track continuity above PARENT's WITHOUT dropping unique causal replacement below half of PARENT's. A policy that survives by acting almost never is SAFE_ABSTENTION and is reported as such.

C1_FLOOR_SPLITS_THE_COMPONENT.FALSIFIER: fewer than 7 splits under SINK_FLOOR, or more than 1 under PARENT
C1_FLOOR_SPLITS_THE_COMPONENT.claim: the per-cell safety floor converts a local excision into a global thinning of the removal band and therefore SPLITS the tracked component
C1_FLOOR_SPLITS_THE_COMPONENT.discovery: SPLIT in 9/9 blocks at both sizes, first failure at t = 976 (L24) and 1280 (L32); PARENT and SRC_CAP: 0 splits
C1_FLOOR_SPLITS_THE_COMPONENT.predicted: SINK_FLOOR splits in at least 7 of 9 blocks at each size under LAW_16, while PARENT splits in at most 1 of 9

C2_HEADROOM_CAP_LOWERS_THE_FLUX.FALSIFIER: SRC_CAP delivering at or above PARENT, which would refute the probe model
C2_HEADROOM_CAP_LOWERS_THE_FLUX.claim: the 08A saturation probe showed the reopening rate is maximal at zero headroom (late/early slope ratio 0.76). A rule that deliberately keeps headroom open must therefore deliver LESS.
C2_HEADROOM_CAP_LOWERS_THE_FLUX.discovery: SRC_CAP delivered 0.314 vs PARENT 0.620 (L24) and 0.228 vs 0.414 (L32), i.e. 0.51 and 0.55 of PARENT
C2_HEADROOM_CAP_LOWERS_THE_FLUX.predicted: SRC_CAP delivered mass lies between 0.35 and 0.75 of PARENT's at both sizes, and is strictly below it in at least 8 of 9 blocks

C3_NO_SAFE_AMOUNT_RULE_IMPROVES_REPLACEM.FALSIFIER: any safe rule beating PARENT on UCR
C3_NO_SAFE_AMOUNT_RULE_IMPROVES_REPLACEM.claim: neither guard improves unique causal replacement
C3_NO_SAFE_AMOUNT_RULE_IMPROVES_REPLACEM.predicted: PARENT's UCR exceeds both SINK_FLOOR's and SRC_CAP's, by paired sign test p < 0.05, at both sizes

C4_PROBE_PREDICTS_RHO_UNDER_A_SECOND_LAW.FALSIFIER: systematic departure beyond 1.5 in source-bound windows
C4_PROBE_PREDICTS_RHO_UNDER_A_SECOND_LAW.claim: the saturation probe is a physical measurement, not a LAW_16 curve fit, so it must predict the delivered rate under LAW_29 too, in source-bound windows
C4_PROBE_PREDICTS_RHO_UNDER_A_SECOND_LAW.predicted: in windows where at least 90 percent of executed events are source-bound, the ratio of probe slope to observed delivery rate lies within a factor 1.5, at both sizes, under LAW_29

dose: 320 opportunities, spacing 16, quantum M256/80, coast 2048, horizon 7424
prohibitions_carried_forward: internal events and internal decisions are never statistical replicates
the nine blocks stay in every ITT analysis including after track loss
survivors are never presented as the complete cohort
delivered mass is a diagnostic, never a substitute for exchange
a magnitude accumulated entirely before dissolution is TRANSIENT_PRE_FAILURE, never a generalised exchange regime
no life / identity / autonomy / metabolism / organisation claim is fabricated
separation: 08A/08B/08C are DISCOVERY on seeds 990000+. 08D is CONFIRMATION on seeds 930000+, which have never been used in any mission of this project. Every number below was computed from discovery data only and is frozen before the first 08D engine call.
